title: Does anyone know any open source models that can produce something like this?
author: Asgavin
selftext:
I am trying to make a card game and after a bunch of attempts I managed to find an artstyle I actually like but the problem is that this image was generated by ChatGPT and apparently the DALL-E model it used isn't open source.

I was wondering if someone knew any open source models that could generate something similar to this so I can actually start to tinker and modify it to match my ideas.

comments.author: democratese
comments.body: Flux2 for sure. I'd send it to Gemini or better yet Claude to get a prompt thats in the neighborhood

comments.author: Lazy-Storage3396
comments.body: unpopular take but you don't need an open source model to match a style. Mage Space has a curated model library that handles fantasy/card art well, tho its browser-based so less tinkering. Stable Diffusion locally gives full control but the setup curve is steep.
